blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Super-resolution and semantic segmentation are known to benefit one another, especially in the Earth observation context. However, learning both tasks in a joint model often requires both task annotations, which is impractical and expensive. In this paper, we study the multi-task partially supervised learning paradigm for both tasks, where each example is assumed to have only a single-task annotation. To that end, we examine two multi-task architectural variations, the sequential and shared variants, then propose a hybrid variant and a re-projection loss to benefit from the shared representation and enforce image quality of super-resolution when training with semantic segmentation. Experiments show favorable results compared to the SOTAs sequential variant. Source codes will be published at https://github.com/lhoangan/munera .
blocks.zh: 超分辨和语义分解已知相互有利,特别是在地球观测背景下. 然而,在联合模式中学习这两个任务往往需要两种任务说明,这是不切实际和昂贵的。 在本文中,我们研究了两个任务的多任务部分监督学习范式,其中每个例子都假定只有一个任务注释. 为此,我们研究了两个多任务建筑变体,相继和共享变体,然后提出混合变体和再投放损失,以在进行语义分解培训时受益于共享代表并强制执行超分辨率的图像质量. 与SOTAs相继变体相比,实验显示出有利的结果. 来源代码将在https://github.com/lhoangan/munera上公布。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Earth observation, which studies and monitors the characteristics and activities on the Earth’s surface, has been attracting the attention of the computer vision community because of its importance and potential. One prominent challenge of Earth observation data is the high variation of data appearances due to geographical differences, e.g . rural compared to urban areas, and due to different capturing sensors and acquisition altitudes, e.g . aerial and satellite platforms. Scaling variation also affects scenes’ detail level, which is generally crucial for semantic-based applications [ 1 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 地球观测研究并监测地表的特征和活动,因其重要性和潜力而吸引了计算机视觉界的注意。 地球观测数据面临的一个突出挑战是,由于地理差异,数据外观差异很大,例如,与城市地区相比,由于捕获传感器和获取高度不同,例如,航空和卫星平台。 缩放变异还影响场景的细节水平,这对于基于语义的应用一般至关重要[1,2].

blocks.en:
Super-resolution, which upsamples images and recovers high-resolution details, could serve as a remedy.
However, it is an ill-posed problem, as there exists, in principle, an infinite number of high-resolution images that, through different degrading processes, result in the same low-resolution input image [ 3 ] .
Categorical information has proven effective in constraining super-resolution [ 4 ] , allowing realistic textural reconstruction [ 5 , 6 ] and improving photo-realistic qualities.
blocks.zh:
超解析法可以提升图像并恢复高解析度细节,作为补救.
然而,这是一个不恰当的问题,因为原则上存在数量无限的高分辨率图像,这些图像通过不同的降解过程导致相同的低分辨率输入图像[3].
事实证明,分类信息有效地制约了超分辨率[4],允许了现实的纹理重建[5,6]并改进了相片现实主义品质.

blocks.en:
As it is known that the multi-task paradigm learns domain-specific information from related tasks to improve one another, jointly learning super-resolution and semantic segmentation in a single model should be reciprocally beneficial for Earth observation applications.
The dual-task model by Wang et al . [ 7 ] with a shared encoder and two task-heads enhancing representation detail levels and predicting semantic segmentation at larger resolutions has been applied to remote sensing by various authors [ 8 , 9 ] while being adapted to different network architectures [ 10 ] . On the other hand, [ 6 ] and [ 4 ] jointly learn semantic segmentation and super-resolution for the super-resolution’s benefit.
Although various approaches in the literature have leveraged one task to improve the performance of the other [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] , focusing on both tasks simultaneously [ 9 , 10 ] remains limited, due to the impractical requirements of annotations for all tasks per training example that multiply the effort in creating a dataset and maintaining task synchronization.
blocks.zh:
众所周知,多任务模式从相关任务中学习特定领域的信息来相互改进,在一个单一模型中共同学习超解分和语义分解,应当对地球观测应用具有互惠性.
Wang et al. [7] 的双任务模型与一个共享编码器和两个任务负责人在较大分辨率上增强代表细节水平并预测语义分解,这些模型被各种作者应用到遥感上[8,9],同时被适应不同的网络架构[10]. 另一方面,[6]和[4]共同学习语义分解和超解,以利超解.
虽然文献中的各种方法利用一项任务改进另一项任务[5、6、7、8]的绩效,同时注重这两项任务[9、10],但由于每个培训实例对所有任务的说明要求不切实际,从而在创建数据集和维持任务同步方面加倍努力。

blocks.en:
Multi-task partially supervised learning [ 11 ] , in which each training example is required to be annotated for only a single task, is proposed to relax the strict requirement of multi-task learning. Without requiring all-task annotations for each training example, multiple datasets already annotated for different tasks can be combined in a single training pipeline, increasing the number of training examples and benefiting from complementary information. Yet, it is not without hindrances. The lack of joint annotations hinders joint optimization during training and requires specific attention regarding the tasks and input data [ 12 ] .
In this paper, we jointly learn super-resolution and semantic segmentation under the same network with a shared encoder using partially annotated datasets for Earth observation. To that end, we propose a re-projection loss to constrain the super-resolution subnet when training with segmentation-annotated data.
blocks.zh:
多任务部分监督学习[11],其中要求每个培训实例只为一项任务作注释,建议放宽多任务学习的严格要求. 在不要求每个培训实例的全任务说明的情况下,可以将已经对不同任务附加说明的多套数据集合并在一个单一的培训管道中,增加培训实例的数量并受益于补充信息。 然而,这不是没有障碍的。 缺乏联合说明妨碍了培训期间的联合优化,需要特别关注任务和输入数据[12]。
在本文中,我们通过使用部分附加说明的地球观测数据集的共享编码器,在同一网络下共同学习超分辨率和语义分解. 为此,我们建议重新预测损失,以便在使用分块附加说明的数据进行培训时限制超分辨率子网。

blocks.en: Despite several works on discriminative tasks such as depth, segmentation, and object detection, the combination of a generative (super-resolution) and a discriminative (semantic segmentation) task is still limited, especially for Earth observation. Similar to our setting are the semantic-guided super-resolution [ 4 ] and super-resolution for image recognition (SR4IR) [ 2 ] , which places a semantic segmentation network after the super-resolution network in a sequential order. Although such a design orients super-resolution toward a downstream task, it places semantic segmentation under the entire influence of super-resolution performance and reduces shared representation. To make the best of both worlds, we propose a hybrid variant that allows shared features as well as adapting super-resolution for a downstream task. The experiments performed on the ISPRS [ 13 ] and proprietary Pleiades-based datasets show favorable results compared to the existing state-of-the-art.
blocks.zh: 尽管在深度、分化和物体探测等歧视性任务方面做了一些工作,但基因分化(超分辨率)和分化(语义分化)任务的结合仍然有限,特别是在地球观测方面。 与我们的设置相类似的还有语义导超分辨率[4]和超分辨率用于图像识别(SR4IR)[2],它将超分辨率网络之后的语义分解网络相继排列. 虽然这种设计将超分辨率导向下游任务,但它将语义分解置于超分辨率性能的全部影响之下并减少共享代表. 为了最佳地利用这两个世界,我们提出了一个混合变体,允许共享特征,并为下游任务调整超分辨率。 在ISPRS [13] 和基于普莱亚德斯的专有数据集上进行的实验显示,与现有的最新技术相比,取得了有利的结果。

blocks.en: The contributions of the paper are as follows: We (1) study the multi-task partial supervised learning for super-resolution and semantic segmentation on Earth observation data, and (2) propose a hybrid variant and a re-projection loss to enforce super-resolution image quality.
blocks.zh: 该文件的贡献如下: (1)研究地球观测数据超分辨率和语义分解的多任务部分监督学习,(2)提出混合变体和再投影损失,以强制超分辨率图像质量.

blocks.en:
For super-resolution, we employ the RRDBNet architecture utilized in the ESRGAN [ 14 ] model with 23 residual-in-residual dense blocks (RRDB) to retain high-level information and increase the encoder’s capacity
before upsampling 4 times (via interpolations and convolutions) and producing the super-resolved image.
For semantic segmentation, the HRNet [ 15 ] architecture is employed, which maintains a stream of embeddings at the input size.
As the RRDBNet encodes the input image while maintaining the resolution of the embeddings, it replaces the first stage of HRNet and acts as the shared encoder E E , leaving the upsampling subnet the super-resolution decoder D R c D^{c}_{R} , with 2 pairs of interpolation-convolution layers (for c = 4 c=4 ) followed by 2 convolution layers. The rest of HRNet becomes the semantic segmentation head D S D_{S} . Interested readers are referred to the original works for more details. As we do not make any assumption on the architecture, this model is architecture-agnostic.
blocks.zh:
为了超解析,我们使用ERRGAN[14]模型中使用的RRDBNet架构,并配有23个残留密集区块(RRDB),以保留高层次信息并增加编码器的能力
在4次(通过插图和演化)进行抽样和产生超解相像之前。
对于语义分解,采用了HRNet[15]架构,该架构保持了输入大小的嵌入流.
由于RRDBNet在维持嵌入的解析度的同时编码了输入图像,它取代了HRNet的第一阶段并充当了共享的编码器E . . . . . . . . . . . 其余的HRNet成为语义分块头 D S QQ S}. 感兴趣的读者可参考原作了解更多详情。 由于我们不对该建筑作任何假设,这个模型是建筑不可知的.

blocks.en: Different from the shared -encoder approach in conventional multi-task models, [ 2 , 4 ] proposed a sequential approach which concatenates a full HRNet to the RRDBNet such that the super-resolved images are fed directly to the HRNet and uses the segmentation loss to guide the super-resolution performance (Figure 1 -(b)). This approach allows maintaining the gradient flow through the super-resolution head when training with segmentation-annotated inputs L S L_{S} , thereby putting the segmentation performance on the entire dependency of super-resolution. To make the best of both worlds, we propose a hybrid head (Figure 1 -(c)) where the shared features are adapted and added to the super-resolved features. The three variants share the same encoder E ( . ) E(.) and two decoders D R ( . ) D_{R}(.) and D S ( . ) D_{S}(.) , as indicated by the same color code. The added blocks to adapt the features are shown explicitly for clarity purposes.

blocks.en:
The ISPRS 2D semantic labeling contest [ 13 ] and the proprietary datasets using real and synthetic Pléiades imagery are employed for experimentation.
Regarding ISPRS, the Potsdam subset is used to train super-resolution and Vaihingen for semantic segmentation and testing.
Following the clean super-resolution (CSR) evaluation strategy [ 17 ] , the LR images are simulated by degrading clean HR images with hidden kernels and injecting noise of unknown statistics. Inspired by [ 4 , 3 , 18 ] we generate 5 × 5 5\times 5 -Gaussian kernels k k with uniformly random lengths, i.e . σ 1 , σ 2 ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.6 , 2.5 ) \sigma_{1},\sigma_{2}\sim\mathcal{U}\left(0.6,2.5\right) , and multiplicative noise up to 25% of the pixels’ values, i.e . k := k ∗ ( 1 + 25 % ​ ϵ ) , where ​ ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) k:=k*(1+25\%\epsilon),\text{ where }\epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1) , to deviate from a regular Gaussian, before normalizing to the sum of 1. The simulated LR images are generated via the well-known model, L = ( H ∗ k ) ↓ c + n , L=\left(H*k\right)\downarrow_{c}+n, (6) where n ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 4 ) n\sim\mathcal{N}(0,4) models the sensor noise. The kernel and noise distribution are kept away from the training process. We apply Eq. 6 with the scale ratio c = 4 c=4 to the Vaihingen images whose original ground sampling distance (GSD) is 9 cm, resulting in (LR, HR) pairs of approximately 36 cm and 9 cm GSD. Conversely, the Potsdam images captured at a GSD of 5 cm are first downsampled 2 times using the bicubic kernel to remove potential noise, before applying Eq. 6 , resulting in training pairs of 40 cm and 10 cm GSD. Validating semantic masks from Vaihingen are downsampled by nearest neighbor following common practices.

For training super-resolution, a synthetic dataset with representative characteristics of the Pléiades sensor, such as spectral bands, FTM, and SNR, is used, comprising 95 LR-HR pairs with the GSDs of 50 cm and 25 cm, respectively.

The Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structure Similarity Index (SSIM) are used for super-resolution, and mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) for semantic segmentation, of which higher is better.
As Pléiades is collected in a real-world setting with no paired HR images, the SR results are presented qualitatively only.

blocks.en: 3.2 Partial multi-task learning
blocks.zh: 3.2 多任务学习

blocks.en: In this subsection, the proposed variants for partial multi-task learning (PMTL) are compared to the state-of-the-art approaches using the sequential variant, namely SR4IR [ 2 ] and SS-guided SR [ 4 ] . To maintain comparability, we follow each paper’s description and re-implement using our codebase. In particular, we respect the choices for losses and their empirical weights, as well as initialize all networks from pretrained models. For SR4IR [ 2 ] , the CQMix augmentation is removed for semantic segmentation as it violates the assumption of multi-task partially supervised learning. All networks are trained for 200K iterations with early stopping at the highest mIOU.
blocks.zh: 在本分节中,将部分多任务学习(PMTL)的拟议变体与采用相继变体即SR4IR [2]和SS-guided SR [4]的先进方法相提并论. 为了保持可比性,我们遵循每份文件的描述,并利用我们的代码库重新实施。 特别是,我们尊重对损失的选择及其经验权重,并从预先训练过的模型中初始化所有网络。 对于SR4IR [2],CQMix增强被去除以进行语义分解,因为它违反了多任务部分监督学习的假设. 所有网络都接受了200K迭代的训练,早期停在最高的mIOU.

blocks.en:
the quantitative results on ISPRS test set are shown in Table 1 . The PMTL approaches outperform both state-of-the-art methods on structure similarity (SSIM) and achieve lower distortion (PSNR), showing higher image quality. The qualitative results on ISPRS in Figure 3 show better textures in our methods compared to the overly smooth SS-guided SR [ 4 ] and blurry SR4IR [ 2 ] .
On Pléiades images (Figure 4 ) and with reference to the bicubic-upsampled version, our results are closer in photometric consistency, especially at brighter areas, where other results contain color leaks in brighter areas due to strong white balance bias that overly whitens the details.

在Pléiades图像(图4)上,并参照双立方体放大镜的版本,我们的结果在光度一致性方面更为接近,特别是在更亮的地区,其他结果中包含在更亮地区的色彩漏出,因为强烈的白色平衡偏差使细节过于白化.

blocks.en: in Table 2 , the hybrid and SOTA-method SR4IR [ 2 ] experience a jump in performance on Vaihingen compared to the other two. Inspection of the confusion matrices in Figure 2 shows that the Background class is absent from the Vaihingen test set, which is recognized by both approaches (in such a case, the common practice disregards the class from mIoU calculation), while the others produce false positive results, which dictates the class being used in the calculation. Both our variants produce similar performance to the SOTA approaches with slight numerical benefits on both Vaihingen and Pléiades datasets.
blocks.zh: 在表2中,混合式和SOTA-方法的SR4IR[2]在Vaihingen的性能上比起其他两种出现了跳跃. 对图2中混淆矩阵的检查表明,Vaihingen测试集没有背景类,这两种方法都承认(在这种情况下,通常的做法忽略了mIoU计算中的分类),而其他方法则产生虚假的正结果,这决定了计算中使用的分类. 我们的两种变体都产生与SOTA方法相似的性能,对Vaihingen和Pléiades数据集都略有数字效益。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
The paper studies the joint learning under the multi-task partially supervised framework for Earth observation imagery.
It is based on the well-known assumption that the two tasks are highly relevant and could contribute to one another. The hybrid architecture is proposed to inherit the best of both shared representation and the semantic-guided sequential variants. The experiments against SOTA sequential methods show higher super-resolution quality both quantitatively and visually, as well as similar semantic segmentation performance with a slight numerical benefit.
blocks.zh:
该文件研究了在地球观测图像多任务部分监督下的联合学习。
其依据是众所周知的假定,即这两项任务具有高度的相关性,可以相互促进。 混合结构被提议继承共享代表和语义引导相继变体中最好的. 针对SOTA相继方法的实验在数量和视觉上都显示出更高的超分辨率质量,以及类似的语义分解性能,略有数值上的效益.
